row: Life West provides a well-balanced approach to education, integrating the fundamental elements of practitioner success: science, technique, philosophy, and business skills. Life West students are trained in more than 13 different chiropractic techniques, and our curriculum offers excellence in hands-on chiropractic education. Find us in the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area, where our students can enjoy an unparalleled experience in lifestyle as well as access to a wide variety of mentors and career opportunities.
